### 7.2.1 ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2 Visualizations: Butyrate Associations

```{r taxon-butyrate-visualizations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, cache=FALSE, dependson="taxon-butyrate-relative"}
# ANCOM-BC2 Forest Plot for Butyrate
if (exists("ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full") && nrow(ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy table for creating proper labels
  tax_table_butyrate <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_butyrate_rel)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),
      Species_clean = stringr::str_replace(Species, "^s__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      # Create label: Genus_Species if both available, otherwise Family if Genus is NA
      taxon_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" &
        !is.na(Species_clean) & Species_clean != "NA" & Species_clean != "" ~ 
          paste0(Genus_clean, "_", Species_clean),
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ taxon
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, taxon_label)
  
  forest_butyrate_data <- ancombc2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_butyrate, by = "taxon") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ci_lower = beta - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = beta + 1.96 * se,
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        q_value < 0.001 ~ "q < 0.001",
        q_value < 0.01 ~ "q < 0.01",
        q_value < 0.05 ~ "q < 0.05",
        q_value < 0.1 ~ "q < 0.1",
        TRUE ~ "q ≥ 0.1"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta)))
  
  # Show top 25 taxa by effect size or all significant ones
  if (sum(forest_butyrate_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    forest_butyrate_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  } else {
    forest_butyrate_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_data %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  }
  
  if (nrow(forest_butyrate_plot_data) > 0) {
    ancombc2_butyrate_forest <- ggplot(
      forest_butyrate_plot_data,
      aes(x = beta, y = reorder(taxon_label, beta), color = significance)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), 
                     height = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("q < 0.001" = "#d73027", 
                   "q < 0.01" = "#f46d43",
                   "q < 0.05" = "#fdae61", 
                   "q < 0.1" = "#fee08b",
                   "q ≥ 0.1" = "gray70"),
        name = "FDR-adjusted\np-value"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "ANCOM-BC2: Taxon Associations with Butyrate",
        subtitle = "Effect sizes (log-fold change per unit butyrate) with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Log-fold change (β)",
        y = "Taxon"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    print(ancombc2_butyrate_forest)
  }
} else {
  cat("No ANCOM-BC2 butyrate results available for visualization\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Volcano Plot for Butyrate
if (exists("maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full") && nrow(maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy for labels
  tax_table_butyrate <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_butyrate_rel)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      genus_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, genus_label)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_plot_data <- maaslin2_butyrate_tbl_rel_full %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_butyrate, by = "feature")
  
  sig_points_butyrate <- maaslin2_butyrate_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_volcano <- ggplot(
    maaslin2_butyrate_plot_data,
    aes(x = coef, y = -log10(q))
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = q < 0.1), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_points_butyrate,
      aes(label = genus_label),
      size = 3,
      color = "#E31A1C",
      fontface = "bold",
      max.overlaps = 20,
      min.segment.length = 0.1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = "#E31A1C"),
      name = "Significant",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "q ≥ 0.1", "TRUE" = "q < 0.1")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MaAsLin2: Taxon Associations with Butyrate",
      subtitle = "Effect Size vs Statistical Significance",
      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size)",
      y = "-log10(q-value)",
      caption = "Red dashed line: q = 0.1 threshold"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  print(maaslin2_butyrate_volcano)
} else {
  cat("No MaAsLin2 butyrate results available for visualization\n")
}
```

## 7.4 Fusicatenibacter–SCFA Correlations

> **Claim retirement (2026-07-19):** The sample-level relative-abundance correlations below are exploratory diagnostics only. Do not report their N, R², or p-values as evidence of a *Fusicatenibacter*–butyrate association. The claim-facing donor-level qPCR-scaled SDC net-change analysis is nonsignificant (Spearman ρ≈0.48, permutation p≈0.088, bootstrap CI includes 0, N=14 donors); see `integrated/results/additional_analyses_2026-07-19/focal_fusicatenibacter/primary_fusicatenibacter_butyrate.csv`.

```{r fusicatenibacter-claim-facing-summary, echo=FALSE}
focal_csv <- file.path(
  "..", "integrated", "results", "additional_analyses_2026-07-19",
  "focal_fusicatenibacter", "primary_fusicatenibacter_butyrate.csv"
)
# Rmd lives in integrated/, so results are a sibling path from the project root.
focal_candidates <- c(
  "results/additional_analyses_2026-07-19/focal_fusicatenibacter/primary_fusicatenibacter_butyrate.csv",
  "../integrated/results/additional_analyses_2026-07-19/focal_fusicatenibacter/primary_fusicatenibacter_butyrate.csv"
)
focal_hit <- focal_candidates[file.exists(focal_candidates)][1]
if (!is.na(focal_hit)) {
  focal <- readr::read_csv(focal_hit, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("Claim-facing donor-level qPCR-scaled Fusicatenibacter–butyrate (SDC net change):\n")
  print(as.data.frame(focal))
} else {
  cat("Claim-facing focal table not found beside this knit; see results/additional_analyses_2026-07-19/focal_fusicatenibacter/.\n")
}
```

```{r fusicatenibacter-scfa-correlations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, cache=FALSE, dependson="scfa-microbiome-integration"}
    timepoint == "48H",
    carbohydrate == "SDC",
    !is.na(scfa_butyrate) | !is.na(scfa_propionate)
  )

# Add relative abundance of Fusicatenibacter
if (length(fusicatenibacter_taxa_rel) > 0) {
  if (length(fusicatenibacter_taxa_rel) > 1) {
    fusicatenibacter_rel_abund <- colSums(
      as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rel))[fusicatenibacter_taxa_rel, , drop = FALSE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    fusicatenibacter_rel_abund <- as.numeric(
      otu_table(ps_rel)[fusicatenibacter_taxa_rel, ]
    )
  }
  
  names(fusicatenibacter_rel_abund) <- sample_names(ps_rel)
  
  corr_data <- corr_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fusicatenibacter_rel = fusicatenibacter_rel_abund[SampleID]
    )
  
  # Filter to samples with Fusicatenibacter data
  corr_data <- corr_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(fusicatenibacter_rel))
  
  # Calculate R² values and correlation statistics for butyrate
  butyrate_data <- corr_data %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scfa_butyrate) & !is.na(fusicatenibacter_rel))
  
  r2_butyrate <- NA_real_
  p_butyrate <- NA_real_
  rho_butyrate <- NA_real_
  
  if (nrow(butyrate_data) > 3) {
    # Linear model for R²
    lm_but <- lm(fusicatenibacter_rel ~ scfa_butyrate, data = butyrate_data)
    r2_butyrate <- summary(lm_but)$r.squared
    p_butyrate <- summary(lm_but)$coefficients[2, 4]
    
    # Spearman correlation
    corr_but <- cor.test(butyrate_data$scfa_butyrate, 
                        butyrate_data$fusicatenibacter_rel,
                        method = "spearman")
    rho_butyrate <- corr_but$estimate
  }
  
  # Calculate R² values and correlation statistics for propionate
  propionate_data <- corr_data %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scfa_propionate) & !is.na(fusicatenibacter_rel))
  
  r2_propionate <- NA_real_
  p_propionate <- NA_real_
  rho_propionate <- NA_real_
  
  if (nrow(propionate_data) > 3) {
    # Linear model for R²
    lm_prop <- lm(fusicatenibacter_rel ~ scfa_propionate, data = propionate_data)
    r2_propionate <- summary(lm_prop)$r.squared
    p_propionate <- summary(lm_prop)$coefficients[2, 4]
    
    # Spearman correlation
    corr_prop <- cor.test(propionate_data$scfa_propionate, 
                         propionate_data$fusicatenibacter_rel,
                         method = "spearman")
    rho_propionate <- corr_prop$estimate
  }
  
  # Create correlation plots with R² annotations
  # Plot 1: Butyrate correlation at 48H, SDC only
  if (nrow(butyrate_data) > 0) {
    corr_butyrate_plot <- ggplot(
      butyrate_data,
      aes(x = scfa_butyrate, y = fusicatenibacter_rel)
    ) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, color = "#56B4E9") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf,
        y = Inf,
        hjust = 1.1,
        vjust = 1.5,
        label = ifelse(!is.na(r2_butyrate), 
                      sprintf("R² = %.3f\np = %.4f", r2_butyrate, p_butyrate),
                      "Insufficient data"),
        size = 5,
        fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Fusicatenibacter vs Butyrate (Relative Abundance)",
        subtitle = "48H timepoint, SDC carbohydrate only",
        x = "Butyrate Concentration (μM)",
        y = "Fusicatenibacter Relative Abundance"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    print(corr_butyrate_plot)
  }
  
  # Plot 2: Propionate correlation at 48H, SDC only
  if (nrow(propionate_data) > 0) {
    corr_propionate_plot <- ggplot(
      propionate_data,
      aes(x = scfa_propionate, y = fusicatenibacter_rel)
    ) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, color = "#E69F00") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf,
        y = Inf,
        hjust = 1.1,
        vjust = 1.5,
        label = ifelse(!is.na(r2_propionate), 
                      sprintf("R² = %.3f\np = %.4f", r2_propionate, p_propionate),
                      "Insufficient data"),
        size = 5,
        fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Fusicatenibacter vs Propionate (Relative Abundance)",
        subtitle = "48H timepoint, SDC carbohydrate only",
        x = "Propionate Concentration (μM)",
        y = "Fusicatenibacter Relative Abundance"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    print(corr_propionate_plot)
  }
  
  # Print correlation statistics summary (DESCRIPTIVE ONLY — not claim-facing)
  cat("\n[DESCRIPTIVE ONLY] Fusicatenibacter-SCFA sample-level correlations (48H, SDC):\n")
  cat("==================================================\n")
  cat("Do not use these as claim-facing results; see focal donor-level table above.\n\n")
  
  if (!is.na(r2_butyrate)) {
    cat(sprintf("Butyrate:\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  R² = %.4f, p = %.4f\n", r2_butyrate, p_butyrate))
    cat(sprintf("  Spearman rho = %.3f\n", rho_butyrate))
    cat(sprintf("  N = %d\n\n", nrow(butyrate_data)))
  } else {
    cat("Butyrate: Insufficient data for correlation analysis\n\n")
  }
  
  if (!is.na(r2_propionate)) {
    cat(sprintf("Propionate:\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  R² = %.4f, p = %.4f\n", r2_propionate, p_propionate))
    cat(sprintf("  Spearman rho = %.3f\n", rho_propionate))
    cat(sprintf("  N = %d\n", nrow(propionate_data)))
  } else {
    cat("Propionate: Insufficient data for correlation analysis\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No Fusicatenibacter taxa found for correlation analysis\n")
}
```

## 7.5 Responder vs Non-Responder Analysis

```{r responder-nonresponder, echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Define responder groups based on delta SCFA (48H - 0H)
# Calculate delta for butyrate and propionate
scfa_delta <- scfa_sample_data_long_factored %>%
  dplyr::filter(analyte %in% c("butyrate", "propionate")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint_hr %in% c("0", "48")) %>%
  # Primary responder definition: one delta per donor × carbohydrate (mean across A/B wells).
  dplyr::group_by(subject, group, carbohydrate_type, analyte) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    conc_0h = mean(concentration[timepoint_hr == "0"], na.rm = TRUE),
    conc_48h = mean(concentration[timepoint_hr == "48"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_48h_0h = conc_48h - conc_0h,
    carbohydrate = dplyr::case_when(
      carbohydrate_type == "no_carbohydrate" ~ "No Added Carb",
      carbohydrate_type == "rapid_digestible" ~ "RDC",
      carbohydrate_type == "slow_digestible" ~ "SDC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    group_micro = dplyr::case_when(
      group == "control" ~ "Healthy",
      group == "case" ~ "Obese",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    donor_id = as.character(subject)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(delta_48h_0h), !is.na(carbohydrate), !is.na(group_micro))

# Define responder/non-responder using a donor-level median split within each
# analyte × carbohydrate stratum.
responder_thresholds <- scfa_delta %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, carbohydrate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_delta = median(delta_48h_0h, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

responder_status <- scfa_delta %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    responder_thresholds,
    by = c("analyte", "carbohydrate")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    responder_status = dplyr::if_else(
      delta_48h_0h >= median_delta,
      "Responder",
      "Non-Responder"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    donor_id, subject, group_micro, carbohydrate, analyte,
    delta_48h_0h, median_delta, responder_status
  )

# Pivot to wide format for overlap analysis
responder_wide <- responder_status %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(donor_id, subject, group_micro, carbohydrate),
    names_from = analyte,
    values_from = responder_status,
    names_prefix = "responder_"
  )

# Examine overlap in responder status
cat("Responder Status Overlap:
")
cat("- Total donor × carbohydrate records:", nrow(responder_wide), "
")
if ("responder_butyrate" %in% colnames(responder_wide) && 
    "responder_propionate" %in% colnames(responder_wide)) {
  overlap_table <- table(
    Butyrate = responder_wide$responder_butyrate,
    Propionate = responder_wide$responder_propionate,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
  print(overlap_table)
  
  # Calculate overlap statistics
  both_responder <- sum(responder_wide$responder_butyrate == "Responder" & 
                        responder_wide$responder_propionate == "Responder", 
                        na.rm = TRUE)
  both_non_responder <- sum(responder_wide$responder_butyrate == "Non-Responder" & 
                           responder_wide$responder_propionate == "Non-Responder", 
                           na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("- Both Responder: %d (%.1f%%)
", both_responder, 
              100 * both_responder / nrow(responder_wide)))
  cat(sprintf("- Both Non-Responder: %d (%.1f%%)
", both_non_responder, 
              100 * both_non_responder / nrow(responder_wide)))
}

# Sensitivity of the median classification to the A/B aliquot split. This is
# not independent validation; it quantifies whether each aliquot falls on the
# same side of the donor-derived threshold.
scfa_delta_aliquot <- scfa_sample_data_long_factored %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    analyte %in% c("butyrate", "propionate"),
    timepoint_hr %in% c("0", "48")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    subject, aliquot_id, carbohydrate_type, analyte
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    conc_0h = mean(concentration[timepoint_hr == "0"], na.rm = TRUE),
    conc_48h = mean(concentration[timepoint_hr == "48"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_48h_0h = conc_48h - conc_0h,
    carbohydrate = dplyr::case_when(
      carbohydrate_type == "no_carbohydrate" ~ "No Added Carb",
      carbohydrate_type == "rapid_digestible" ~ "RDC",
      carbohydrate_type == "slow_digestible" ~ "SDC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    donor_id = as.character(subject)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(delta_48h_0h), !is.na(carbohydrate)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    responder_thresholds,
    by = c("analyte", "carbohydrate")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    aliquot_responder_status = dplyr::if_else(
      delta_48h_0h >= median_delta,
      "Responder",
      "Non-Responder"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    responder_status %>%
      dplyr::select(
        donor_id, carbohydrate, analyte,
        donor_responder_status = responder_status
      ),
    by = c("donor_id", "carbohydrate", "analyte")
  )

aliquot_classification_stability <- scfa_delta_aliquot %>%
  dplyr::filter(carbohydrate %in% c("RDC", "SDC")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, carbohydrate, donor_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_aliquots = dplyr::n(),
    aliquots_same_side = dplyr::n_distinct(aliquot_responder_status) == 1,
    aliquot_matches_donor = mean(
      aliquot_responder_status == donor_responder_status
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analyte, carbohydrate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    donors = dplyr::n(),
    donors_with_A_B_same_side = sum(aliquots_same_side),
    percent_donors_A_B_same_side = 100 * mean(aliquots_same_side),
    percent_aliquot_labels_matching_donor = 100 * mean(aliquot_matches_donor),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge responder status with microbiome metadata at 48H
ps_48h_resp <- phyloseq::subset_samples(ps, timepoint == "48H")

# Match responder status on donor_id (person-level labels).
sample_meta_resp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_resp)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    donor_id = as.character(donor_id)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    responder_wide,
    by = c("donor_id" = "donor_id",
           "group" = "group_micro",
           "carbohydrate" = "carbohydrate")
  )

# Update phyloseq sample_data
sample_data(ps_48h_resp)$responder_butyrate <- sample_meta_resp$responder_butyrate
sample_data(ps_48h_resp)$responder_propionate <- sample_meta_resp$responder_propionate

cat("
48H Microbiome Composition Comparison:
")
cat("- Samples with responder status:", 
    sum(!is.na(sample_data(ps_48h_resp)$responder_butyrate)), "
")
```

### 7.5.1 Sensitivity of Responder Classification to A/B Aliquots

```{r responder-aliquot-stability, echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, dependson="responder-nonresponder"}
aliquot_stability_table <- aliquot_classification_stability %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Analyte = stringr::str_to_title(analyte),
    Carbohydrate = carbohydrate,
    Donors = donors,
    `Donors with A/B on same side` = donors_with_A_B_same_side,
    `Donors with A/B on same side (%)` = percent_donors_A_B_same_side,
    `Aliquot labels matching donor label (%)` =
      percent_aliquot_labels_matching_donor
  )

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  DT::datatable(
    aliquot_stability_table,
    caption = paste(
      "Sensitivity of median-defined responder labels to A/B aliquot changes.",
      "This is a reproducibility diagnostic, not independent validation."
    ),
    options = list(pageLength = 4, dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE),
    rownames = FALSE
  ) %>%
    DT::formatRound(
      columns = c(
        "Donors with A/B on same side (%)",
        "Aliquot labels matching donor label (%)"
      ),
      digits = 1
    )
} else {
  knitr::kable(
    aliquot_stability_table,
    digits = 1,
    caption = "Sensitivity of responder labels to A/B aliquot changes"
  )
}
```

Across the active-carbohydrate responder classifications, the A and B aliquots fell on the same side of the donor-derived median threshold for `r min(aliquot_classification_stability$donors_with_A_B_same_side)` to `r max(aliquot_classification_stability$donors_with_A_B_same_side)` of 16 donors, depending on analyte and carbohydrate. This sensitivity supports retaining continuous donor-level delta as the primary interpersonal-variation outcome and treating median-defined responder analyses as secondary.

## 7.6 Microbial Composition Differences: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders

To explore whether donor-level SCFA response strata are associated with microbiome composition, we classified donors as "Responders" or "Non-Responders" based on their change in SCFA concentration from baseline (0H) to 48 hours (48H). These sample-dependent median strata are used only for secondary microbiome comparisons; they are not tests of SCFA response variance and do not define a validated responder phenotype.

**Definition of Responder Status:**
- For each SCFA (butyrate and propionate) and each carbohydrate condition (RDC and SDC), we calculated the delta change: Δ = [SCFA]₄₈ₕ - [SCFA]₀ₕ
- Subjects were classified separately for each analyte and carbohydrate type using a median split approach
- **Responders**: Subjects with Δ ≥ median Δ for that specific analyte-carbohydrate combination
- **Non-Responders**: Subjects with Δ < median Δ for that specific analyte-carbohydrate combination

This exploratory approach asks whether donors with larger observed SCFA increases also differ in concurrent microbial community features. It does not establish prediction, mechanism, or a clinically meaningful response threshold.

In this section, we compare the microbial composition (alpha diversity, beta diversity, and community structure) between butyrate responders and non-responders at the 48H timepoint, focusing on samples from RDC and SDC conditions (excluding No Added Carb controls).

```{r butyrate-responder-composition, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, cache=FALSE, dependson="responder-nonresponder"}
# Compare microbial composition between butyrate responder groups at 48H
ps_48h_butyrate_resp <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_48h_resp,
  !is.na(responder_butyrate) & carbohydrate != "No Added Carb"
)

if (nsamples(ps_48h_butyrate_resp) > 5) {
  # Alpha diversity comparison
  alpha_butyrate_resp <- estimate_richness(
    ps_48h_butyrate_resp,
    measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_butyrate_resp)) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
        dplyr::select(SampleID, responder_butyrate, carbohydrate),
      by = "SampleID"
    )
  
  # Plot alpha diversity
  alpha_butyrate_resp_long <- alpha_butyrate_resp %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Observed, Shannon, Simpson),
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    )
  
  alpha_resp_plot <- ggplot(
    alpha_butyrate_resp_long,
    aes(x = responder_butyrate, y = value, fill = responder_butyrate)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      aes(group = responder_butyrate),
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = Inf,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "Alpha Diversity: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (48H)",
      subtitle = "Comparison across RDC and SDC conditions (Wilcoxon test p-values shown)",
      x = "Butyrate Response Status",
      y = "Alpha Diversity",
      fill = "Response Status"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  print(alpha_resp_plot)
  
  # Calculate and display Wilcoxon test statistics
  alpha_butyrate_wilcox <- tryCatch({
    alpha_butyrate_resp_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
      dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(responder_butyrate) == 2) %>%
      rstatix::wilcox_test(value ~ responder_butyrate, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
      rstatix::add_significance() %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error calculating alpha_butyrate_wilcox:", e$message, "\n")
    tibble::tibble()
  })
  
  # Check available columns and select appropriate ones
  if (nrow(alpha_butyrate_wilcox) > 0) {
    # Check what columns exist (p.adj vs p_adjust)
    p_adj_col <- intersect(c("p.adj", "p_adjust", "adj.p.value"), names(alpha_butyrate_wilcox))
    p_adj_col <- if (length(p_adj_col) > 0) p_adj_col[1] else NULL
    
    p_signif_col <- intersect(c("p.adj.signif", "p_adjust_signif", "signif"), names(alpha_butyrate_wilcox))
    p_signif_col <- if (length(p_signif_col) > 0) p_signif_col[1] else NULL
    
    # Create adjusted p-value if it doesn't exist
    if (is.null(p_adj_col) && "p" %in% names(alpha_butyrate_wilcox)) {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj <- p.adjust(alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p, method = "BH")
    } else if (!is.null(p_adj_col)) {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj <- alpha_butyrate_wilcox[[p_adj_col]]
    } else {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj <- NA_real_
    }
    
    # Create significance column if it doesn't exist
    if (is.null(p_signif_col)) {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj_signif <- dplyr::case_when(
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
        alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.1 ~ ".",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    } else {
      alpha_butyrate_wilcox$p_adj_signif <- alpha_butyrate_wilcox[[p_signif_col]]
    }
    
    cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (Alpha Diversity)\n")
    cat("================================================================================\n")
    print(alpha_butyrate_wilcox %>%
            dplyr::select(metric, group1, group2, p, p_adj, p_adj_signif) %>%
            dplyr::rename(
              Metric = metric,
              Group1 = group1,
              Group2 = group2,
              `p value` = p,
              `p adjusted` = p_adj,
              Significance = p_adj_signif
            ))
  } else {
    cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (Alpha Diversity)\n")
    cat("================================================================================\n")
    cat("Insufficient data for Wilcoxon tests\n")
  }
  
  # Beta diversity comparison
  ps_48h_butyrate_resp_rel <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(
    ps_48h_butyrate_resp, 
    function(x) {
      total <- sum(x)
      if (total > 0) x / total else x
    }
  )
  
  dist_bray_resp <- phyloseq::distance(
    ps_48h_butyrate_resp_rel, 
    method = "bray"
  )
  
  meta_resp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_butyrate_resp_rel))
  
  # PCoA
  pcoa_resp <- ape::pcoa(as.matrix(dist_bray_resp))
  pcoa_df_resp <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pcoa_resp$vectors[, 1],
    PC2 = pcoa_resp$vectors[, 2],
    responder_butyrate = meta_resp$responder_butyrate,
    carbohydrate = meta_resp$carbohydrate
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(responder_butyrate))
  
  pcoa_plot_resp <- ggplot(
    pcoa_df_resp,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = responder_butyrate)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = responder_butyrate), level = 0.68) +
    facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate) +
    scale_color_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "Beta Diversity: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders (48H)",
      subtitle = "Bray-Curtis PCoA",
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * pcoa_resp$values$Relative_eig[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * pcoa_resp$values$Relative_eig[2], 1), "%)"),
      color = "Response Status"
    ) +
    theme_scfa()
  
  print(pcoa_plot_resp)
  
  # PERMANOVA
  perm_resp <- vegan::adonis2(
    dist_bray_resp ~ responder_butyrate * carbohydrate,
    data = meta_resp,
    strata = meta_resp$donor_id,
    permutations = 999
  )
  
  cat("
PERMANOVA: Butyrate Responder Status (48H):
")
  print(perm_resp)
  
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for butyrate responder composition comparison
")
}
```

### 7.6.1 Differential Abundance Analysis: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders

To identify specific taxa that differ between butyrate responders and non-responders, we performed differential abundance analysis using ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2.

```{r butyrate-responder-da, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-", fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Prepare genus-level phyloseq object for DA analysis
ps_butyrate_resp_genus <- tax_glom(ps_48h_butyrate_resp, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ps_butyrate_resp_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 0, ps_butyrate_resp_genus)

# Filter to samples with responder status
ps_butyrate_resp_genus <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_butyrate_resp_genus,
  !is.na(responder_butyrate) & carbohydrate != "No Added Carb"
)

# ANCOM-BC2 Analysis
if (nsamples(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 10 && ntaxa(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 1) {
  # Remove samples with too many zeros
  zero_prop <- apply(otu_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus), 2, function(x) sum(x == 0) / length(x))
  problematic_samples <- names(zero_prop[zero_prop > 0.95])
  
  if (length(problematic_samples) > 0) {
    ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean <- subset_samples(
      ps_butyrate_resp_genus, 
      !sample_names(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) %in% problematic_samples
    )
  } else {
    ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean <- ps_butyrate_resp_genus
  }
  
  # Ensure responder_butyrate is a factor
  sample_data(ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean)$responder_butyrate <- as.factor(
    sample_data(ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean)$responder_butyrate
  )
  
  ancombc2_butyrate_resp <- tryCatch({
    ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
      data = ps_butyrate_resp_genus_clean,
      tax_level = "Genus",
      fix_formula = "responder_butyrate + carbohydrate",
      rand_formula = "(1|donor_id)",
      p_adj_method = "BH",
      prv_cut = 0.10,
      lib_cut = 0,
      s0_perc = 0.05,
      group = "responder_butyrate",
      struc_zero = TRUE,
      neg_lb = TRUE,
      alpha = 0.05,
      global = TRUE,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder failed:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  # Extract ANCOM-BC2 results
  if (!is.null(ancombc2_butyrate_resp) && !is.null(ancombc2_butyrate_resp$res)) {
    res_data_butyrate_resp <- ancombc2_butyrate_resp$res
    
    # Get effect for responder_butyrateResponder (vs Non-Responder as reference)
    effect_name <- "responder_butyrateResponder"
    lfc_col <- paste0("lfc_", effect_name)
    se_col <- paste0("se_", effect_name)
    p_col <- paste0("p_", effect_name)
    q_col <- paste0("q_", effect_name)
    
    if (all(c(lfc_col, se_col, p_col, q_col) %in% colnames(res_data_butyrate_resp))) {
      ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- res_data_butyrate_resp %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          effect = "Responder vs Non-Responder",
          beta = .data[[lfc_col]],
          se = .data[[se_col]],
          p_value = .data[[p_col]],
          q_value = .data[[q_col]]
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(taxon, effect, beta, se, p_value, q_value) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(q_value)
      
      cat("ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder:", 
          sum(ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
          "significant taxa (q < 0.1)\n")
    } else {
      ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
        taxon = character(0),
        effect = character(0),
        beta = numeric(0),
        se = numeric(0),
        p_value = numeric(0),
        q_value = numeric(0)
      )
    }
  } else {
    ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      taxon = character(0),
      effect = character(0),
      beta = numeric(0),
      se = numeric(0),
      p_value = numeric(0),
      q_value = numeric(0)
    )
  }
} else {
  ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    taxon = character(0),
    effect = character(0),
    beta = numeric(0),
    se = numeric(0),
    p_value = numeric(0),
    q_value = numeric(0)
  )
  cat("Insufficient samples for ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder analysis\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Analysis
if (nsamples(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 5 && ntaxa(ps_butyrate_resp_genus) > 1) {
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus))
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) {
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts <- t(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts)
  }
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      donor_id = as.character(donor_id),
    aliquot_id = as.character(aliquot_id),
    subject_id = as.character(subject_id),
      responder_butyrate = as.factor(responder_butyrate),
      carbohydrate = as.factor(carbohydrate)
    )
  rownames(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_meta) <- sample_names(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit <- tryCatch({
    suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
      capture.output(
        maaslin2_butyrate_resp_result <- Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
          input_data = maaslin2_butyrate_resp_counts,
          input_metadata = maaslin2_butyrate_resp_meta,
          output = tempfile(pattern = "maaslin2_butyrate_resp_", tmpdir = getwd()),
          min_prevalence = 0.05,
          normalization = "TSS",
          transform = "LOG",
          analysis_method = "LM",
          fixed_effects = c("responder_butyrate", "carbohydrate"),
          random_effects = c("donor_id"),
          plot_heatmap = FALSE,
          plot_scatter = FALSE
        ),
        file = nullfile()
      )
    ))
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_result
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("MaAsLin2 butyrate responder failed:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  # Extract MaAsLin2 results
  if (!is.null(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit) && !is.null(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit$results)) {
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- maaslin2_butyrate_resp_fit$results %>%
      dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(metadata == "responder_butyrate") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(q)
    
    cat("MaAsLin2 butyrate responder:", 
        sum(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl$q < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        "significant associations (q < 0.1)\n")
  } else {
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      feature = character(0),
      metadata = character(0),
      value = character(0),
      coef = numeric(0),
      pval = numeric(0),
      q = numeric(0)
    )
  }
} else {
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    feature = character(0),
    metadata = character(0),
    value = character(0),
    coef = numeric(0),
    pval = numeric(0),
    q = numeric(0)
  )
  cat("Insufficient samples for MaAsLin2 butyrate responder analysis\n")
}
```

### 7.6.2 ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2 Visualizations: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders

```{r butyrate-responder-da-visualizations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, cache=FALSE, dependson="butyrate-responder-da"}
# ANCOM-BC2 Forest Plot
if (exists("ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl") && nrow(ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy table for creating proper labels
  # For genus-level analysis, taxon names are genus names (e.g., "g__GenusName" or "g__NA")
  # We need to handle cases where Genus is NA - use Family in those cases
  tax_table_butyrate_resp <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_value = as.character(Genus),
      Family_value = as.character(Family),
      Species_value = as.character(Species),
      # Create taxon key for matching (handle NA genera)
      taxon = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(Genus_value) | Genus_value == "NA" | Genus_value == "g__NA",
        paste0("f__", stringr::str_replace(Family_value, "^f__", "")),
        Genus_value
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(taxon, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus_value, "^g__", ""),
      Species_clean = stringr::str_replace(Species_value, "^s__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family_value, "^f__", ""),
      # Create label: Genus_Species if both available, otherwise Family if Genus is NA
      taxon_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" &
        !is.na(Species_clean) & Species_clean != "NA" & Species_clean != "" ~ 
          paste0(Genus_clean, "_", Species_clean),
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ taxon
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, taxon_label)
  
  # Also create a mapping for NA genera - map "g__NA" to Family-based taxon key
  # ANCOM-BC2 might return "g__NA" for taxa without genus assignments
  na_genus_mapping <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "NA" | Genus == "g__NA") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      taxon_na = "g__NA",
      Family_value = as.character(Family),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family_value, "^f__", ""),
      taxon_label = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "",
        Family_clean,
        "Unclassified"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(taxon_na, taxon_label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon = taxon_na, taxon_label)
  
  # Combine both mappings
  tax_table_butyrate_resp <- dplyr::bind_rows(tax_table_butyrate_resp, na_genus_mapping) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(taxon, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  forest_butyrate_resp_data <- ancombc2_butyrate_resp_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_butyrate_resp, by = "taxon") %>%
    # If join failed, try to create label from taxon name directly
    dplyr::mutate(
      taxon_label = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(taxon_label) | taxon_label == "NA",
        dplyr::case_when(
          stringr::str_detect(taxon, "^f__") ~ stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^f__", ""),
          stringr::str_detect(taxon, "^g__") ~ stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^g__", ""),
          TRUE ~ taxon
        ),
        taxon_label
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ci_lower = beta - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = beta + 1.96 * se,
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        q_value < 0.001 ~ "q < 0.001",
        q_value < 0.01 ~ "q < 0.01",
        q_value < 0.05 ~ "q < 0.05",
        q_value < 0.1 ~ "q < 0.1",
        TRUE ~ "q ≥ 0.1"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta)))
  
  # Show top 25 taxa by effect size or all significant ones
  if (sum(forest_butyrate_resp_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_resp_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  } else {
    forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data <- forest_butyrate_resp_data %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  }
  
  if (nrow(forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data) > 0) {
    ancombc2_butyrate_resp_forest <- ggplot(
      forest_butyrate_resp_plot_data,
      aes(x = beta, y = reorder(taxon_label, beta), color = significance)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), 
                     height = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("q < 0.001" = "#d73027", 
                   "q < 0.01" = "#f46d43",
                   "q < 0.05" = "#fdae61", 
                   "q < 0.1" = "#fee08b",
                   "q ≥ 0.1" = "gray70"),
        name = "FDR-adjusted\np-value"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "ANCOM-BC2: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders",
        subtitle = "Effect sizes (log-fold change: Responder vs Non-Responder) with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Log-fold change (β)",
        y = "Genus",
        caption = "Positive values indicate higher abundance in Responders"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    print(ancombc2_butyrate_resp_forest)
  } else {
    cat("No data available for ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder forest plot\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No ANCOM-BC2 butyrate responder results available for visualization\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Volcano Plot
if (exists("maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl") && nrow(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy for labels
  tax_table_butyrate_resp <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_butyrate_resp_genus)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      genus_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, genus_label)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_plot_data <- maaslin2_butyrate_resp_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_butyrate_resp, by = "feature")
  
  sig_points_butyrate_resp <- maaslin2_butyrate_resp_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)
  
  maaslin2_butyrate_resp_volcano <- ggplot(
    maaslin2_butyrate_resp_plot_data,
    aes(x = coef, y = -log10(q))
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = q < 0.1), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_points_butyrate_resp,
      aes(label = genus_label),
      size = 3,
      color = "#E31A1C",
      fontface = "bold",
      max.overlaps = 20,
      min.segment.length = 0.1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = "#E31A1C"),
      name = "Significant",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "q ≥ 0.1", "TRUE" = "q < 0.1")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MaAsLin2: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders",
      subtitle = "Effect Size vs Statistical Significance",
      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size: Responder vs Non-Responder)",
      y = "-log10(q-value)",
      caption = "Red dashed line: q = 0.1 threshold; Positive values indicate higher abundance in Responders"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  print(maaslin2_butyrate_resp_volcano)
} else {
  cat("No MaAsLin2 butyrate responder results available for visualization\n")
}
```

## 7.7 Microbial Composition Differences: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders

Following the same responder classification approach described in Section 7.6, we compare the microbial composition between propionate responders and non-responders at the 48H timepoint. Propionate responder status was determined using a median split of the delta change in propionate concentration (48H - 0H) for each carbohydrate condition separately. This analysis examines whether individuals with greater propionate production responses have distinct microbial communities compared to those with smaller responses.

```{r propionate-responder-composition, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, cache=FALSE, dependson="responder-nonresponder"}
# Compare microbial composition between propionate responder groups at 48H
ps_48h_propionate_resp <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_48h_resp,
  !is.na(responder_propionate) & carbohydrate != "No Added Carb"
)

if (nsamples(ps_48h_propionate_resp) > 5) {
  # Alpha diversity comparison
  alpha_propionate_resp <- estimate_richness(
    ps_48h_propionate_resp,
    measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_propionate_resp)) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
        dplyr::select(SampleID, responder_propionate, carbohydrate),
      by = "SampleID"
    )
  
  alpha_propionate_resp_long <- alpha_propionate_resp %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Observed, Shannon, Simpson),
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    )
  
  alpha_prop_resp_plot <- ggplot(
    alpha_propionate_resp_long,
    aes(x = responder_propionate, y = value, fill = responder_propionate)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      aes(group = responder_propionate),
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = Inf,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "Alpha Diversity: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders (48H)",
      subtitle = "Comparison across RDC and SDC conditions (Wilcoxon test p-values shown)",
      x = "Propionate Response Status",
      y = "Alpha Diversity",
      fill = "Response Status"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  print(alpha_prop_resp_plot)
  
  # Calculate and display Wilcoxon test statistics
  alpha_propionate_wilcox <- tryCatch({
    alpha_propionate_resp_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
      dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(responder_propionate) == 2) %>%
      rstatix::wilcox_test(value ~ responder_propionate, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
      rstatix::add_significance() %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error calculating alpha_propionate_wilcox:", e$message, "\n")
    tibble::tibble()
  })
  
  # Check available columns and select appropriate ones
  if (nrow(alpha_propionate_wilcox) > 0) {
    # Check what columns exist (p.adj vs p_adjust)
    p_adj_col <- intersect(c("p.adj", "p_adjust", "adj.p.value"), names(alpha_propionate_wilcox))
    p_adj_col <- if (length(p_adj_col) > 0) p_adj_col[1] else NULL
    
    p_signif_col <- intersect(c("p.adj.signif", "p_adjust_signif", "signif"), names(alpha_propionate_wilcox))
    p_signif_col <- if (length(p_signif_col) > 0) p_signif_col[1] else NULL
    
    # Create adjusted p-value if it doesn't exist
    if (is.null(p_adj_col) && "p" %in% names(alpha_propionate_wilcox)) {
      alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj <- p.adjust(alpha_propionate_wilcox$p, method = "BH")
    } else if (!is.null(p_adj_col)) {
      alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj <- alpha_propionate_wilcox[[p_adj_col]]
    } else {
      alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj <- NA_real_
    }
    
    # Create significance column if it doesn't exist
    if (is.null(p_signif_col)) {
      alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj_signif <- dplyr::case_when(
        alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
        alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
        alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj < 0.1 ~ ".",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    } else {
      alpha_propionate_wilcox$p_adj_signif <- alpha_propionate_wilcox[[p_signif_col]]
    }
    
    cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders (Alpha Diversity)\n")
    cat("==================================================================================\n")
    print(alpha_propionate_wilcox %>%
            dplyr::select(metric, group1, group2, p, p_adj, p_adj_signif) %>%
            dplyr::rename(
              Metric = metric,
              Group1 = group1,
              Group2 = group2,
              `p value` = p,
              `p adjusted` = p_adj,
              Significance = p_adj_signif
            ))
  } else {
    cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders (Alpha Diversity)\n")
    cat("==================================================================================\n")
    cat("Insufficient data for Wilcoxon tests\n")
  }
  
  # Beta diversity comparison
  ps_48h_propionate_resp_rel <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(
    ps_48h_propionate_resp, 
    function(x) {
      total <- sum(x)
      if (total > 0) x / total else x
    }
  )
  
  dist_bray_prop_resp <- phyloseq::distance(
    ps_48h_propionate_resp_rel, 
    method = "bray"
  )
  
  meta_prop_resp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_48h_propionate_resp_rel))
  
  # PCoA
  pcoa_prop_resp <- ape::pcoa(as.matrix(dist_bray_prop_resp))
  pcoa_df_prop_resp <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pcoa_prop_resp$vectors[, 1],
    PC2 = pcoa_prop_resp$vectors[, 2],
    responder_propionate = meta_prop_resp$responder_propionate,
    carbohydrate = meta_prop_resp$carbohydrate
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(responder_propionate))
  
  pcoa_plot_prop_resp <- ggplot(
    pcoa_df_prop_resp,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = responder_propionate)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = responder_propionate), level = 0.68) +
    facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate) +
    scale_color_scfa() +
    labs(
      title = "Beta Diversity: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders (48H)",
      subtitle = "Bray-Curtis PCoA",
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * pcoa_prop_resp$values$Relative_eig[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * pcoa_prop_resp$values$Relative_eig[2], 1), "%)"),
      color = "Response Status"
    ) +
    theme_scfa()
  
  print(pcoa_plot_prop_resp)
  
  # PERMANOVA
  perm_prop_resp <- vegan::adonis2(
    dist_bray_prop_resp ~ responder_propionate * carbohydrate,
    data = meta_prop_resp,
    strata = meta_prop_resp$donor_id,
    permutations = 999
  )
  
  cat("
PERMANOVA: Propionate Responder Status (48H):
")
  print(perm_prop_resp)
  
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for propionate responder composition comparison
")
}
```

### 7.7.1 Differential Abundance Analysis: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders

To identify specific taxa that differ between propionate responders and non-responders, we performed differential abundance analysis using ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2.

```{r propionate-responder-da, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/integrated-", fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Prepare genus-level phyloseq object for DA analysis
ps_prop_resp_genus <- tax_glom(ps_48h_propionate_resp, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ps_prop_resp_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_prop_resp_genus) > 0, ps_prop_resp_genus)

# Filter to samples with responder status
ps_prop_resp_genus <- phyloseq::subset_samples(
  ps_prop_resp_genus,
  !is.na(responder_propionate) & carbohydrate != "No Added Carb"
)

# ANCOM-BC2 Analysis
if (nsamples(ps_prop_resp_genus) > 10 && ntaxa(ps_prop_resp_genus) > 1) {
  # Remove samples with too many zeros
  zero_prop <- apply(otu_table(ps_prop_resp_genus), 2, function(x) sum(x == 0) / length(x))
  problematic_samples <- names(zero_prop[zero_prop > 0.95])
  
  if (length(problematic_samples) > 0) {
    ps_prop_resp_genus_clean <- subset_samples(
      ps_prop_resp_genus, 
      !sample_names(ps_prop_resp_genus) %in% problematic_samples
    )
  } else {
    ps_prop_resp_genus_clean <- ps_prop_resp_genus
  }
  
  # Ensure responder_propionate is a factor
  sample_data(ps_prop_resp_genus_clean)$responder_propionate <- as.factor(
    sample_data(ps_prop_resp_genus_clean)$responder_propionate
  )
  
  ancombc2_prop_resp <- tryCatch({
    ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
      data = ps_prop_resp_genus_clean,
      tax_level = "Genus",
      fix_formula = "responder_propionate + carbohydrate",
      rand_formula = "(1|donor_id)",
      p_adj_method = "BH",
      prv_cut = 0.10,
      lib_cut = 0,
      s0_perc = 0.05,
      group = "responder_propionate",
      struc_zero = TRUE,
      neg_lb = TRUE,
      alpha = 0.05,
      global = TRUE,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ANCOM-BC2 propionate responder failed:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  # Extract ANCOM-BC2 results
  if (!is.null(ancombc2_prop_resp) && !is.null(ancombc2_prop_resp$res)) {
    res_data_prop_resp <- ancombc2_prop_resp$res
    
    # Get effect for responder_propionateResponder (vs Non-Responder as reference)
    effect_name <- "responder_propionateResponder"
    lfc_col <- paste0("lfc_", effect_name)
    se_col <- paste0("se_", effect_name)
    p_col <- paste0("p_", effect_name)
    q_col <- paste0("q_", effect_name)
    
    if (all(c(lfc_col, se_col, p_col, q_col) %in% colnames(res_data_prop_resp))) {
      ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl <- res_data_prop_resp %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          effect = "Responder vs Non-Responder",
          beta = .data[[lfc_col]],
          se = .data[[se_col]],
          p_value = .data[[p_col]],
          q_value = .data[[q_col]]
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(taxon, effect, beta, se, p_value, q_value) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(q_value)
      
      cat("ANCOM-BC2 propionate responder:", 
          sum(ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
          "significant taxa (q < 0.1)\n")
    } else {
      ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
        taxon = character(0),
        effect = character(0),
        beta = numeric(0),
        se = numeric(0),
        p_value = numeric(0),
        q_value = numeric(0)
      )
    }
  } else {
    ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      taxon = character(0),
      effect = character(0),
      beta = numeric(0),
      se = numeric(0),
      p_value = numeric(0),
      q_value = numeric(0)
    )
  }
} else {
  ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    taxon = character(0),
    effect = character(0),
    beta = numeric(0),
    se = numeric(0),
    p_value = numeric(0),
    q_value = numeric(0)
  )
  cat("Insufficient samples for ANCOM-BC2 propionate responder analysis\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Analysis
if (nsamples(ps_prop_resp_genus) > 5 && ntaxa(ps_prop_resp_genus) > 1) {
  maaslin2_prop_resp_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_prop_resp_genus))
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_prop_resp_genus)) {
    maaslin2_prop_resp_counts <- t(maaslin2_prop_resp_counts)
  }
  
  maaslin2_prop_resp_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_prop_resp_genus)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      donor_id = as.character(donor_id),
    aliquot_id = as.character(aliquot_id),
    subject_id = as.character(subject_id),
      responder_propionate = as.factor(responder_propionate),
      carbohydrate = as.factor(carbohydrate)
    )
  rownames(maaslin2_prop_resp_meta) <- sample_names(ps_prop_resp_genus)
  
  maaslin2_prop_resp_fit <- tryCatch({
    suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
      capture.output(
        maaslin2_prop_resp_result <- Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
          input_data = maaslin2_prop_resp_counts,
          input_metadata = maaslin2_prop_resp_meta,
          output = tempfile(pattern = "maaslin2_prop_resp_", tmpdir = getwd()),
          min_prevalence = 0.05,
          normalization = "TSS",
          transform = "LOG",
          analysis_method = "LM",
          fixed_effects = c("responder_propionate", "carbohydrate"),
          random_effects = c("donor_id"),
          plot_heatmap = FALSE,
          plot_scatter = FALSE
        ),
        file = nullfile()
      )
    ))
    maaslin2_prop_resp_result
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("MaAsLin2 propionate responder failed:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  # Extract MaAsLin2 results
  if (!is.null(maaslin2_prop_resp_fit) && !is.null(maaslin2_prop_resp_fit$results)) {
    maaslin2_prop_resp_tbl <- maaslin2_prop_resp_fit$results %>%
      dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(metadata == "responder_propionate") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(q)
    
    cat("MaAsLin2 propionate responder:", 
        sum(maaslin2_prop_resp_tbl$q < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
        "significant associations (q < 0.1)\n")
  } else {
    maaslin2_prop_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      feature = character(0),
      metadata = character(0),
      value = character(0),
      coef = numeric(0),
      pval = numeric(0),
      q = numeric(0)
    )
  }
} else {
  maaslin2_prop_resp_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    feature = character(0),
    metadata = character(0),
    value = character(0),
    coef = numeric(0),
    pval = numeric(0),
    q = numeric(0)
  )
  cat("Insufficient samples for MaAsLin2 propionate responder analysis\n")
}
```

### 7.7.2 ANCOM-BC2 and MaAsLin2 Visualizations: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders

```{r propionate-responder-da-visualizations, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, cache=FALSE, dependson="propionate-responder-da"}
# ANCOM-BC2 Forest Plot
if (exists("ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl") && nrow(ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy table for creating proper labels
  # For genus-level analysis, taxon names are genus names (e.g., "g__GenusName" or "g__NA")
  # We need to handle cases where Genus is NA - use Family in those cases
  tax_table_prop_resp <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_prop_resp_genus)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_value = as.character(Genus),
      Family_value = as.character(Family),
      Species_value = as.character(Species),
      # Create taxon key for matching (handle NA genera)
      taxon = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(Genus_value) | Genus_value == "NA" | Genus_value == "g__NA",
        paste0("f__", stringr::str_replace(Family_value, "^f__", "")),
        Genus_value
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(taxon, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus_value, "^g__", ""),
      Species_clean = stringr::str_replace(Species_value, "^s__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family_value, "^f__", ""),
      # Create label: Genus_Species if both available, otherwise Family if Genus is NA
      taxon_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" &
        !is.na(Species_clean) & Species_clean != "NA" & Species_clean != "" ~ 
          paste0(Genus_clean, "_", Species_clean),
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ taxon
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, taxon_label)
  
  # Also create a mapping for NA genera - map "g__NA" to Family-based taxon key
  # ANCOM-BC2 might return "g__NA" for taxa without genus assignments
  na_genus_mapping <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_prop_resp_genus)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "NA" | Genus == "g__NA") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      taxon_na = "g__NA",
      Family_value = as.character(Family),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family_value, "^f__", ""),
      taxon_label = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "",
        Family_clean,
        "Unclassified"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(taxon_na, taxon_label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon = taxon_na, taxon_label)
  
  # Combine both mappings
  tax_table_prop_resp <- dplyr::bind_rows(tax_table_prop_resp, na_genus_mapping) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(taxon, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  forest_prop_resp_data <- ancombc2_prop_resp_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_prop_resp, by = "taxon") %>%
    # If join failed, try to create label from taxon name directly
    dplyr::mutate(
      taxon_label = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(taxon_label) | taxon_label == "NA",
        dplyr::case_when(
          stringr::str_detect(taxon, "^f__") ~ stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^f__", ""),
          stringr::str_detect(taxon, "^g__") ~ stringr::str_replace(taxon, "^g__", ""),
          TRUE ~ taxon
        ),
        taxon_label
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ci_lower = beta - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = beta + 1.96 * se,
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        q_value < 0.001 ~ "q < 0.001",
        q_value < 0.01 ~ "q < 0.01",
        q_value < 0.05 ~ "q < 0.05",
        q_value < 0.1 ~ "q < 0.1",
        TRUE ~ "q ≥ 0.1"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta)))
  
  # Show top 25 taxa by effect size or all significant ones
  if (sum(forest_prop_resp_data$q_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    forest_prop_resp_plot_data <- forest_prop_resp_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  } else {
    forest_prop_resp_plot_data <- forest_prop_resp_data %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(beta))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  }
  
  if (nrow(forest_prop_resp_plot_data) > 0) {
    ancombc2_prop_resp_forest <- ggplot(
      forest_prop_resp_plot_data,
      aes(x = beta, y = reorder(taxon_label, beta), color = significance)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), 
                     height = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("q < 0.001" = "#d73027", 
                   "q < 0.01" = "#f46d43",
                   "q < 0.05" = "#fdae61", 
                   "q < 0.1" = "#fee08b",
                   "q ≥ 0.1" = "gray70"),
        name = "FDR-adjusted\np-value"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "ANCOM-BC2: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders",
        subtitle = "Effect sizes (log-fold change: Responder vs Non-Responder) with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Log-fold change (β)",
        y = "Genus",
        caption = "Positive values indicate higher abundance in Responders"
      ) +
      theme_scfa() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    print(ancombc2_prop_resp_forest)
  } else {
    cat("No data available for ANCOM-BC2 propionate responder forest plot\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No ANCOM-BC2 propionate responder results available for visualization\n")
}

# MaAsLin2 Volcano Plot
if (exists("maaslin2_prop_resp_tbl") && nrow(maaslin2_prop_resp_tbl) > 0) {
  # Get taxonomy for labels
  tax_table_prop_resp <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_prop_resp_genus)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus_clean = stringr::str_replace(Genus, "^g__", ""),
      Family_clean = stringr::str_replace(Family, "^f__", ""),
      genus_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "NA" & Genus_clean != "" ~ Genus_clean,
        !is.na(Family_clean) & Family_clean != "NA" & Family_clean != "" ~ Family_clean,
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature, genus_label)
  
  maaslin2_prop_resp_plot_data <- maaslin2_prop_resp_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_table_prop_resp, by = "feature")
  
  sig_points_prop_resp <- maaslin2_prop_resp_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(q < 0.1)
  
  maaslin2_prop_resp_volcano <- ggplot(
    maaslin2_prop_resp_plot_data,
    aes(x = coef, y = -log10(q))
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = q < 0.1), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_points_prop_resp,
      aes(label = genus_label),
      size = 3,
      color = "#E31A1C",
      fontface = "bold",
      max.overlaps = 20,
      min.segment.length = 0.1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = "#E31A1C"),
      name = "Significant",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "q ≥ 0.1", "TRUE" = "q < 0.1")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MaAsLin2: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders",
      subtitle = "Effect Size vs Statistical Significance",
      x = "Coefficient (Effect Size: Responder vs Non-Responder)",
      y = "-log10(q-value)",
      caption = "Red dashed line: q = 0.1 threshold; Positive values indicate higher abundance in Responders"
    ) +
    theme_scfa() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  print(maaslin2_prop_resp_volcano)
} else {
  cat("No MaAsLin2 propionate responder results available for visualization\n")
}
```

## 7.8 qPCR-Scaled Fusicatenibacter Abundance: Responders vs Non-Responders

> **Claim retirement (2026-07-19):** Pooled responder Wilcoxon tests on well-level qPCR-scaled *Fusicatenibacter* abundances are exploratory only. They dichotomize a continuous SCFA outcome, retain multiple records per donor, and are not SDC-specific when pooled. Prefer the continuous donor-level net-change association in `results/additional_analyses_2026-07-19/focal_fusicatenibacter/`. These values are **qPCR-scaled** (relative × total load), not genus-specific absolute qPCR.

```{r fusicatenibacter-abs-responders, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, cache=FALSE, dependson=c("absolute-abundance-conversion", "responder-nonresponder")}
# EXPLORATORY / DESCRIPTIVE ONLY — not claim-facing.
# Extract qPCR-scaled Fusicatenibacter abundance and merge with responder status
# Find all ASVs assigned to Fusicatenibacter genus
fusicatenibacter_taxa_abs <- taxa_names(ps_genus_abs_obj)[
  stringr::str_detect(tax_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[, "Genus"], regex("Fusicatenibacter", ignore_case = TRUE))
]

if (length(fusicatenibacter_taxa_abs) > 0) {
  # Get absolute abundance for Fusicatenibacter genus
  if (length(fusicatenibacter_taxa_abs) > 1) {
    fusicatenibacter_abs_all <- colSums(otu_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[fusicatenibacter_taxa_abs, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    fusicatenibacter_abs_all <- as.numeric(otu_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[fusicatenibacter_taxa_abs, ])
  }
  
  # Get metadata and merge with responder status
  meta_abs_resp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_genus_abs_obj)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fusicatenibacter_abs_abund = fusicatenibacter_abs_all,
      donor_id = as.character(donor_id),
      has_qpcr = !is.na(genome_copies_per_ul)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_qpcr, timepoint == "48H", !is.na(carbohydrate), carbohydrate != "No Added Carb")
  
  # Merge with responder status
  if (exists("responder_wide") && nrow(responder_wide) > 0) {
    meta_abs_resp <- meta_abs_resp %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        responder_wide %>%
          dplyr::mutate(donor_id = as.character(donor_id)) %>%
          dplyr::select(donor_id, carbohydrate, responder_butyrate, responder_propionate),
        by = c("donor_id", "carbohydrate")
      )
    
    # Butyrate Responder Analysis
    if ("responder_butyrate" %in% colnames(meta_abs_resp)) {
      butyrate_resp_data <- meta_abs_resp %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(responder_butyrate), !is.na(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund))
      
      if (nrow(butyrate_resp_data) > 0) {
        # Statistical test
        butyrate_wilcox <- tryCatch({
          rstatix::wilcox_test(
            fusicatenibacter_abs_abund ~ responder_butyrate,
            data = butyrate_resp_data,
            p.adjust.method = "BH"
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        # Summary statistics
        butyrate_summary <- butyrate_resp_data %>%
          dplyr::group_by(responder_butyrate, carbohydrate) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            median_abs = median(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_abs = mean(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_abs = sd(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
            n = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        # Plot
        plot_butyrate_abs <- ggplot(
          butyrate_resp_data,
          aes(x = responder_butyrate, y = fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, fill = responder_butyrate)
        ) +
          geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
          geom_jitter(aes(color = responder_butyrate), alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, size = 1.2) +
          facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate, scales = "free_y") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, trans = "log10") +
          labs(
            title = "Absolute Fusicatenibacter Abundance: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders",
            subtitle = "48H timepoint, genome copies per μL (log10 scale)",
            x = "Butyrate Responder Status",
            y = "Absolute Fusicatenibacter Abundance\n(genome copies per μL, log10 scale)",
            fill = "Responder Status",
            color = "Responder Status"
          ) +
          theme_scfa() +
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "bottom"
          )
        
        # Add statistical comparisons using stat_compare_means
        plot_butyrate_abs <- plot_butyrate_abs +
          ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
            method = "wilcox.test",
            comparisons = list(c("Responder", "Non-Responder")),
            label = "p.format",
            vjust = -0.5
          )
        
        print(plot_butyrate_abs)
        
        # Print summary
        cat("\n### Butyrate Responder Analysis:\n")
        print(butyrate_summary)
        if (!is.null(butyrate_wilcox) && nrow(butyrate_wilcox) > 0) {
          cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results:\n")
          print(butyrate_wilcox)
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Propionate Responder Analysis
    if ("responder_propionate" %in% colnames(meta_abs_resp)) {
      propionate_resp_data <- meta_abs_resp %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(responder_propionate), !is.na(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund))
      
      if (nrow(propionate_resp_data) > 0) {
        # Statistical test
        propionate_wilcox <- tryCatch({
          rstatix::wilcox_test(
            fusicatenibacter_abs_abund ~ responder_propionate,
            data = propionate_resp_data,
            p.adjust.method = "BH"
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        # Summary statistics
        propionate_summary <- propionate_resp_data %>%
          dplyr::group_by(responder_propionate, carbohydrate) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            median_abs = median(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_abs = mean(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_abs = sd(fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
            n = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        # Plot
        plot_propionate_abs <- ggplot(
          propionate_resp_data,
          aes(x = responder_propionate, y = fusicatenibacter_abs_abund, fill = responder_propionate)
        ) +
          geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
          geom_jitter(aes(color = responder_propionate), alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, size = 1.2) +
          facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate, scales = "free_y") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, trans = "log10") +
          labs(
            title = "Absolute Fusicatenibacter Abundance: Propionate Responders vs Non-Responders",
            subtitle = "48H timepoint, genome copies per μL (log10 scale)",
            x = "Propionate Responder Status",
            y = "Absolute Fusicatenibacter Abundance\n(genome copies per μL, log10 scale)",
            fill = "Responder Status",
            color = "Responder Status"
          ) +
          theme_scfa() +
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "bottom"
          )
        
        # Add statistical comparisons using stat_compare_means
        plot_propionate_abs <- plot_propionate_abs +
          ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
            method = "wilcox.test",
            comparisons = list(c("Responder", "Non-Responder")),
            label = "p.format",
            vjust = -0.5
          )
        
        print(plot_propionate_abs)
        
        # Print summary
        cat("\n### Propionate Responder Analysis:\n")
        print(propionate_summary)
        if (!is.null(propionate_wilcox) && nrow(propionate_wilcox) > 0) {
          cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results:\n")
          print(propionate_wilcox)
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    cat("Responder status data not available. Please run responder-nonresponder chunk first.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Fusicatenibacter taxa not found in absolute abundance data.\n")
}
```

## 7.9 qPCR-Scaled Bifidobacterium Abundance: Responders vs Non-Responders

> **Descriptive only:** Same caveats as Section 7.8 — qPCR-scaled (not genus-specific qPCR), exploratory median-split responder strata, not claim-facing.

To determine whether qPCR-scaled *Bifidobacterium* abundance differs between SCFA responders and non-responders, we compared scaled abundance levels at the 48H timepoint. This uses total bacterial 16S qPCR load × relative abundance.

```{r bifidobacterium-abs-responders, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, cache=FALSE, dependson=c("absolute-abundance-conversion", "responder-nonresponder")}
# EXPLORATORY / DESCRIPTIVE ONLY — not claim-facing.
# Extract qPCR-scaled Bifidobacterium abundance and merge with responder status
# Find all ASVs assigned to Bifidobacterium genus
bifidobacterium_taxa_abs <- taxa_names(ps_genus_abs_obj)[
  stringr::str_detect(tax_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[, "Genus"], regex("Bifidobacterium", ignore_case = TRUE))
]

if (length(bifidobacterium_taxa_abs) > 0) {
  # Get absolute abundance for Bifidobacterium genus
  if (length(bifidobacterium_taxa_abs) > 1) {
    bifidobacterium_abs_all <- colSums(otu_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[bifidobacterium_taxa_abs, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    bifidobacterium_abs_all <- as.numeric(otu_table(ps_genus_abs_obj)[bifidobacterium_taxa_abs, ])
  }
  
  # Get metadata and merge with responder status
  meta_abs_resp_bif <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_genus_abs_obj)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bifidobacterium_abs_abund = bifidobacterium_abs_all,
      donor_id = as.character(donor_id),
      has_qpcr = !is.na(genome_copies_per_ul)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_qpcr, timepoint == "48H", !is.na(carbohydrate), carbohydrate != "No Added Carb")
  
  # Merge with responder status
  if (exists("responder_wide") && nrow(responder_wide) > 0) {
    meta_abs_resp_bif <- meta_abs_resp_bif %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        responder_wide %>%
          dplyr::mutate(donor_id = as.character(donor_id)) %>%
          dplyr::select(donor_id, carbohydrate, responder_butyrate, responder_propionate),
        by = c("donor_id", "carbohydrate")
      )
    
    # Butyrate Responder Analysis
    if ("responder_butyrate" %in% colnames(meta_abs_resp_bif)) {
      butyrate_resp_data_bif <- meta_abs_resp_bif %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(responder_butyrate), !is.na(bifidobacterium_abs_abund))
      
      if (nrow(butyrate_resp_data_bif) > 0) {
        # Statistical test
        butyrate_wilcox_bif <- tryCatch({
          rstatix::wilcox_test(
            bifidobacterium_abs_abund ~ responder_butyrate,
            data = butyrate_resp_data_bif,
            p.adjust.method = "BH"
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        # Summary statistics
        butyrate_summary_bif <- butyrate_resp_data_bif %>%
          dplyr::group_by(responder_butyrate, carbohydrate) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            median_abs = median(bifidobacterium_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_abs = mean(bifidobacterium_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_abs = sd(bifidobacterium_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
            n = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        # Plot
        plot_butyrate_abs_bif <- ggplot(
          butyrate_resp_data_bif,
          aes(x = responder_butyrate, y = bifidobacterium_abs_abund, fill = responder_butyrate)
        ) +
          geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
          geom_jitter(aes(color = responder_butyrate), alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, size = 1.2) +
          facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate, scales = "free_y") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, trans = "log10") +
          labs(
            title = "Absolute Bifidobacterium Abundance: Butyrate Responders vs Non-Responders",
            subtitle = "48H timepoint, genome copies per μL (log10 scale)",
            x = "Butyrate Responder Status",
            y = "Absolute Bifidobacterium Abundance\n(genome copies per μL, log10 scale)",
            fill = "Responder Status",
            color = "Responder Status"
          ) +
          theme_scfa() +
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "bottom"
          )
        
        # Add statistical comparisons using stat_compare_means
        plot_butyrate_abs_bif <- plot_butyrate_abs_bif +
          ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
            method = "wilcox.test",
            comparisons = list(c("Responder", "Non-Responder")),
            label = "p.format",
            vjust = -0.5
          )
        
        print(plot_butyrate_abs_bif)
        
        # Print summary
        cat("\n### Butyrate Responder Analysis:\n")
        print(butyrate_summary_bif)
        if (!is.null(butyrate_wilcox_bif) && nrow(butyrate_wilcox_bif) > 0) {
          cat("\nWilcoxon Test Results:\n")
          print(butyrate_wilcox_bif)
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Propionate Responder Analysis
    if ("responder_propionate" %in% colnames(meta_abs_resp_bif)) {
      propionate_resp_data_bif <- meta_abs_resp_bif %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(responder_propionate), !is.na(bifidobacterium_abs_abund))
      
      if (nrow(propionate_resp_data_bif) > 0) {
        # Statistical test
        propionate_wilcox_bif <- tryCatch({
          rstatix::wilcox_test(
            bifidobacterium_abs_abund ~ responder_propionate,
            data = propionate_resp_data_bif,
            p.adjust.method = "BH"
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        # Summary statistics
        propionate_summary_bif <- propionate_resp_data_bif %>%
          dplyr::group_by(responder_propionate, carbohydrate) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            median_abs = median(bifidobacterium_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_abs = mean(bifidobacterium_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_abs = sd(bifidobacterium_abs_abund, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
            n = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        # Plot
        plot_propionate_abs_bif <- ggplot(
          propionate_resp_data_bif,
          aes(x = responder_propionate, y = bifidobacterium_abs_abund, fill = responder_propionate)
        ) +
          geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
          geom_jitter(aes(color = responder_propionate), alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, size = 1.2) +
          facet_wrap(~ carbohydrate, scales = "free_y") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#2E8B57", "Non-Responder" = "#CD5C5C")) +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, trans = "log10") +
          labs(

            subtitle = "48H timepoint, genome copies per μL (log10 scale)",
            x = "Propionate Responder Status",

        # Add statistical comparisons using stat_compare_means
```
